'''Sarutahiko Shrine''' (猿田彦神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} dedicated to {{ill|Sarutahiko Ōkami|en|Sarutahiko Ōkami|qid=Q3090037|lt=Sarutahiko Ōkami}}, enshrined under this name. Such shrines are found throughout Japan, with {{ill|Tsubaki Grand Shrine|en|Tsubaki Grand Shrine|qid=Q3541617|lt=Tsubaki Grand Shrine}} in {{ill|Suzuka, Mie|ar|سوزوكا (ميه)|azb|سوزوکا، میه|be|Судзука|bg|Судзука|ca|Suzuka|ce|Судзука (гӀала)|ceb|Suzuka|ckb|سزوکا (میێ)|cs|Suzuka (Mie)|da|Suzuka|de|Suzuka|eo|Suzuka|es|Suzuka (Mie)|et|Suzuka|fa|سوزوکا، میه|fi|Suzuka|fr|Suzuka (Mie)|gl|Suzuka|hu|Szuzuka|hy|Սուձուկա|id|Suzuka, Mie|it|Suzuka|ja|鈴鹿市|ko|스즈카시|lt|Sudzuka|lv|Sudzuka|mg|Suzuka|ms|Suzuka, Mie|mzn|سوزوکا، میه|nl|Suzuka (stad)|no|Suzuka|pl|Suzuka (miasto)|pt|Suzuka|ro|Suzuka|ru|Судзука (город)|sh|Suzuka|simple|Suzuka, Mie|sr|Сузука|sv|Suzuka|tg|Сузука|th|ซูซูกะ|tl|Susuka, Mie|tr|Suzuka, Mie|tt|Судзука (шәһәр)|uk|Судзука (Міє)|ur|سوزوکا، میہ|vi|Suzuka, Mie|war|Suzuka, Mie|zh|鈴鹿市|zh_classical|鈴鹿市|zh_min_nan|Suzuka-chhī|zh_yue|鈴鹿|qid=Q207311|lt=Suzuka, Mie}} claiming to be the "Sarutahiko Grand Shrine Headquarters."
